exercises.title: Verify a root-owned file (sudo/root QA)
exercises.instructions: Author-only, disposable administrator sandbox. First inspect `id`, `groups`, `sudo -l` and the sandbox root transition. Never modify the VM or host. In /workspace create qa-sudo/root.txt, then use the permitted sandbox administrator identity to set owner root:root and mode 0640. Verify with `stat`. The trusted verifier checks the resulting inode, NOT which command you typed. A missing file must fail before you create it.
